context_requirements: Expression of HCN channels (HCN1-4), particularly HCN2/HCN3, on the cell membrane
Functional HCN-mediated inward current contributing to membrane potential or Ca2+ homeostasis
Proliferative or ER-stress-sensitive state for secondary transcriptional consequences
falsifiers: No change in cholesterol biosynthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1) at 24 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
No UPR/ER-stress gene induction at 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent transcriptional responses in all nine lines, including HA1E, which would suggest a non-specific effect

evidence.supports: Ivabradine, an HCN channel blocker, inhibits breast cancer cell proliferation and enriches cholesterol biosynthesis and ER-stress pathways
HCN channel blockers attenuate embryonic stem cell proliferation and alter cell cycle progression
Ivabradine reduces fibrosis markers and inflammation in a rat model, indicating potential transcriptional effects on ECM and stress pathways
